task.objective: 以冒溢为中心，给出全场概览，对每个冒溢节点／事件分析发生过程、可能机制和证据缺口；先交付初步诊断，随后再补证。

value.window_policy: one saved neighbor before/after; may require longer investigation

topology_scope.direction_basis: input from_node/to_node; not inferred actual flow or causal direction
limitations: Upstream scope retains only each target incoming link and its endpoint.
Downstream scope retains the first confluence, facility, special node or terminal boundary.
No side branches or extra links at corridor/boundary nodes are automatically included.
A pure downstream split stops with partial coverage; selecting further paths requires supplementation.
Target direct exchanges remain visible when the target itself splits; no branch is followed beyond them.
Intermediate lateral inflows are node processes, not additional direct target sources.
Topology completeness does not establish causal completeness; reversals may need investigation.

value.direct_source_scope: Only target incident links and target aggregate lateral; never sum corridor flows as new sources

value.share_meaning: direct entering composition, not flood contribution
value.total_inflow_role: comparison only; never added as a source

value.initial_state_source: input_fields in local_structure, not inferred from first report sample

value.reason: No source attribution inferred from nearest cell

evidence_selection.background_scope: Whole-run statistics remain background; do not substitute them for event values.
limitations: Local packages cover only their saved process window; missing values remain unknown.
Initial scope uses one upstream segment and downstream to a retained boundary, without side-branch expansion; it does not guarantee all causes are covered.
Global statistics are not individual-object or causal diagnosis.

model_context.method: all native junction overflow is external to the 1D network; mapping weight=1
model_context.diagnosis_instruction: baseline is KINWAVE: do not infer backwater, pressurized-flow or hydraulic flow reversal from it. Use dynamic_wave for those mechanisms.
model_context.surface_interpretation: CA2D is synthetic one-way overflow spreading; it is not complete distributed rainfall, infiltration or sewer re-entry.
model_context.map_scale_status: assumed area-informed local scale; not surveyed
model_context.note: Catchment 8 drains directly to outfall 18, bypassing the conduit network, as in the original.

numeric_precision.calculation_order: detect events and calculate statistics before rounding
numeric_precision.interpretation: Rounded evidence values are approximate; use saved sources for recalculation.
